name: Science Communication and Popularization
benefit:
Popularization of Science is one of the key programs initiated by the Council to promote scientific temper among the citizens of Uttarakhand, particularly the youth. A number of activities are conducted under this program. 
The Council provides financial assistance for organizing various events such as seminars, workshops, and conferences. It also organizes popular lectures and celebrates National
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be an educational, research, or development organization, or an NGO based in Uttarakhand.
